scopes.accounts:read: See owned fictional accounts, balances, available balances and account status. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.transactions:read: See recent fictional transaction amounts, descriptions, dates, status and categories. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.cards:read: See fictional cards, last four digits, status, limits and linked accounts. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.recipients:read: See existing fictional payment recipients and masked destination details. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.budgets:read: See fictional monthly budgets, category limits and simulated spending. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.cards:write: Freeze or unfreeze a fictional card. Reversible, but every change requires separate approval. Does not include reading cards.
scopes.transactions:write: Change a posted fictional transaction's category. Reversible, with separate approval. Does not include reading transactions.
scopes.budgets:write: Create or update fictional budgets. Reversible, with separate approval. Does not include reading budgets.
scopes.payments:request: Request an outgoing fictional payment to an existing recipient. Irreversible in this demo after approval; no real money moves.
scopes.transfers:request: Request a fictional transfer between owned accounts. Treated as irreversible after approval; no real money moves.
scopes.fdx:ACCOUNT_BASIC: FDX-shaped API: see the fictional accounts you choose at consent (type, name, masked number, status), without balances. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.fdx:ACCOUNT_DETAILED: FDX-shaped API: add current and available balances to the accounts you choose. Needs fdx:ACCOUNT_BASIC to list them. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.fdx:TRANSACTIONS: FDX-shaped API: see the transactions of the fictional accounts you choose. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.fdx:STATEMENTS: FDX-shaped API: list and download monthly PDF statements of the fictional accounts you choose, with their balances and transactions. Read only; includes personal financial data.
scopes.fdx:CUSTOMER_CONTACT: FDX-shaped API: see the fictional customer's name and email. Read only; includes personal data.
scopes.offline_access: Allow the Personal Agent to refresh this fictional grant while you are away, for up to 7 days. Without it, the grant ends with its first access token, after 1 hour. It does not add data or change permissions.
scopes.poppy:browser-sign-in: Open Harborline's website in the agent's own browser, signed in to your account. The website shows what the read permissions you grant cover, and nothing can be changed there. Not needed for the API or for Harborline's own agent.
